Name: Simple Standard Farm
Author: zydlar
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bUcS3oA.png[/img]

Ever been bothered by the unsymmetrical design of the standard farm map? Hated the fact that the bodies of water on the map ruin your space to just plant crops, crops and more crops?

Then this Map replacement mod is for you!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/UX8Mg2S.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Removal of the two bodies of water from the map
[*]Added water trough next to shipping bin
[*]Straighten left hand border of the map to remove the outcrop of land.  
[*]Squared off the bottom right and top left corners to give a more squared layout. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1QvnqDt.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip/extract the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37782][CP] Simple Standard Farm[/url]﻿ folder into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI to play!
[/list]
To uninstall and return to the base Standard Farm map, delete the [CP] Simple Standard Farm folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hRcv1vo.png[/img]
